Thursday said preliminary third quarter revenue was ~$1.1 million, a ~40% growth compared with the second quarter and up 55% from the year ago period. SenesTech
It was also the company's first quarter at or above the $1 million revenue threshold, a key milestone, SenesTech

The company expects its definitive third quarter financial results to reflect continued momentum in e-commerce, including higher subscription revenue, which is expanding the recurring component of SenesTech's revenue base, as well as increasing traction in B2B.

"Our preliminary third quarter revenue marks an important milestone for SenesTech, reaching the $1 million threshold for the first time and setting a second consecutive quarterly record," said Michael Edell, CEO of SenesTech.

"This is another quarter demonstrating progress on the plans and strategies we have previously announced, and our full third quarter financial results are expected to reflect that progress across the commercial model we have been building."

title: SenesTech stock dips even as preliminary Q3 revenue crosses $1M milestone
